name: Samsung SDS Co.,Ltd.
summary: Samsung SDS Co.,Ltd. delivers a comprehensive array of software solutions and IT services, serving clients both within South Korea and globally. Its advanced artificial intelligence (AI) portfolio features Brightics AI, a business-optimized platform encompassing machine learning, deep learning, data preparation and management, visual search, analytics, and AI acceleration. Complementing this is Brightics IoT, which seamlessly links IoT devices to big data systems and existing infrastructure, facilitating the creation of smart applications on top of integrated data flows. For blockchain technology, the company provides Nexledger Universal, an enterprise-grade platform, alongside Nexledger Accelerator, which speeds up corporate blockchain transactions. Cloud offerings include enterprise network services and various cloud applications, such as Brity RPA, an AI-powered intelligent automation tool designed to boost productivity. Samsung SDS is also a key provider of smart logistics solutions. These encompass global supply chain management, offering services like outsourcing, expert assessment, consulting, international risk management, operational optimization, strategic planning, and value-added services. Its freight forwarding capabilities span air, express, sea, multimodal, local, and specialized cargo transport. Warehousing and distribution services involve logistics network design, strategic warehouse planning and operation, and fulfillment. The company also handles e-commerce and project logistics, supported by platforms such as Cello for general logistics, Cello square for digital forwarding, Cello trust for blockchain-enhanced supply chain traceability, and Cello digital services for IT-driven logistics. Beyond these core areas, Samsung SDS delivers Nexfinance, an integrated digital financial platform; a digital identity platform; digital health solutions; the Nexplant 3D eXcellence platform; enterprise mobility management (EMM) products, including those for wearable devices; video conferencing; and IP telephony services. Founded in 1985, the company is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea.
